title: Reviews
description: What customers wrote after a rental

help.title: About reviews
help.overview: A customer can leave one review from the manage link after the car is back. It shows on your site and the portal at once.

sections.title: On this page
items: You cannot change, hide or delete a review. If one breaks the rules, report it to the platform from its menu.
A booking can have only one review.
